name_zh: 极光 X9 无线降噪耳机
description_en: The Aurora X9 pairs 40 mm graphene drivers with hybrid active noise cancellation that adapts to your surroundings 200 times per second. A 45-hour battery, multipoint Bluetooth 5.3 and a featherlight 245 g frame make it the everyday companion for commutes and deep work.
description_zh: 极光 X9 采用 40 毫米石墨烯单元，混合主动降噪每秒 200 次自适应环境变化。45 小时续航、蓝牙 5.3 双设备连接与仅 245 克的轻量机身，是通勤与专注工作的日常搭档。

reviews.author: Priya
reviews.comment: Ancient-plane roar simply disappears. Best commute upgrade I have bought in years.

reviews.author: Marcus
reviews.comment: Multipoint switching between laptop and phone is flawless, and the battery easily lasts my week.

reviews.author: Elena
reviews.comment: Superb sound and comfort; the touch controls took a day to get used to.

description_en: A 15.6-inch 3K OLED display and a 12-core processor wrapped in a 1.35 kg aluminium chassis. The Nimbus 15 Pro stays whisper-quiet under load and still delivers a full workday of 11-hour battery.
description_zh: 云帆 15 Pro 配备 15.6 英寸 3K OLED 屏与 12 核处理器，铝合金机身仅 1.35 公斤。高负载下依旧安静冷静，11 小时电池足以支撑整个工作日。

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.comment: The OLED screen is stunning for photo editing and the fan is basically inaudible.

reviews.author: Sofia
reviews.comment: Fast, light and well built. I wish it had one more USB-A port.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.comment: Compiles our codebase noticeably faster than my old machine and survives a full day of meetings.

name_zh: 脉动 Fit 5 智能手表
description_en: PulseFit 5 tracks 120+ sport modes, blood oxygen and sleep stages on an always-on AMOLED display. Dual-band GPS locks your running route in seconds and the battery stretches to 14 days between charges.
description_zh: 脉动 Fit 5 支持 120 余种运动模式，常亮 AMOLED 屏上呈现血氧与睡眠分期。双频 GPS 数秒锁定跑步轨迹，续航长达 14 天。

reviews.author: Ava
reviews.comment: Route tracking is spot on even under dense trees, and two weeks of battery is liberating.

reviews.author: Ken
reviews.comment: Accurate heart rate for intervals; third-party watch faces would be nice.

reviews.author: Lucia
reviews.comment: Sleep staging matches how I actually feel in the morning. The vibration alarm is gentle but effective.

description_en: A 30 W stereo driver set with passive radiators that fills a room — or a campsite — without distortion. IP67 waterproofing and 20-hour playback make the EchoBeam as happy outdoors as on a desk.
description_zh: 30 瓦立体声单元与无源辐射器，无论房间还是营地都饱满无损。IP67 防水与 20 小时播放，室内户外同样从容。

reviews.author: Ravi
reviews.comment: Took it rafting — dunked it twice, kept playing. Sound is far bigger than the box.

reviews.author: Mia
reviews.comment: Great mids and vocals; at max volume the bass thins out a little.

reviews.author: Jonas
reviews.comment: Pairing two of them in stereo mode on the patio was effortless.

description_en: A native 4K picture at 2200 ISO lumens with automatic keystone and focus, so movie night starts in seconds. The LumiView throws a usable 100-inch image from just 2.5 metres and runs streaming apps natively.
description_zh: 流明视以 2200 ISO 流明呈现原生 4K 画面，自动梯形校正与对焦，数秒开启家庭影院。2.5 米即可投出 100 英寸画面，内置流媒体应用。

reviews.author: Grace
reviews.comment: Replaced our TV entirely. Sharp text, vivid colour, and setup took five minutes.

reviews.author: Victor
reviews.comment: Bright enough with curtains open; built-in apps cover everything we watch.

reviews.author: Hana
reviews.comment: The auto focus is magic for kids' movie nights — they move it, it fixes itself.

description_en: A Sony sensor with HDR keeps you well-lit against windows, and on-device framing keeps you centred without a subscription. The privacy shutter and mute indicator are physical, not software.
description_zh: 索尼传感器配合 HDR，逆光依旧清晰；端侧取景始终把你保持在画面中央，无需订阅。隐私快门与静音指示均为物理设计。

reviews.author: Omar
reviews.comment: Colours finally look right on video calls, even with a bright window behind me.

reviews.author: Becky
reviews.comment: Auto framing is smooth. Would love 4K, but at this price it is a steal.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.comment: Physical privacy shutter was the deciding factor — and the image quality is excellent anyway.

name_zh: 疾充 100W 氮化镓充电器
description_en: Four ports, 100 W total, and a pocketable GaN body that stays cool even while charging a laptop and two phones at once. Intelligent power splitting means nothing fights for watts.
description_zh: 四口合计 100W，氮化镓机身小巧且低温，可同时为笔记本与两部手机快充。智能功率分配，多设备互不争抢。

reviews.author: Lena
reviews.comment: One brick now travels with me for laptop, tablet and phone. Barely warm under full load.

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.comment: Charges my 16-inch laptop at full speed and still has ports to spare.

reviews.author: Yuki
reviews.comment: Compact and reliable; the folded prongs would make it perfect.

name_zh: 云雀迷你 4K 航拍无人机
description_en: Under 249 g so it dodges registration in most regions, yet it films stabilised 4K/30 with a 3-axis gimbal. 31 minutes of flight, automatic return-to-home and subject tracking come standard.
description_zh: 重量不足 249 克，多数地区免注册；三轴云台稳定输出 4K/30 视频。31 分钟续航，自动返航与智能跟拍皆为标配。

reviews.author: Andres
reviews.comment: Footage looks gimbal-smooth in coastal wind. It is genuinely pocketable.

reviews.author: Nora
reviews.comment: Beginner-friendly with return-to-home. Wind above 30 km/h is its limit.

reviews.author: Felix
reviews.comment: Subject tracking on my bike rides is reliable and the battery claims are honest.

name_zh: 醇萃大师 Pro 意式咖啡机
description_en: A 58 mm commercial group head and PID-controlled thermoblock pull cafe-grade shots, while the steam wand turns milk into microfoam in 20 seconds. Built-in burr grinder with 30 settings closes the loop from bean to cup.
description_zh: 58 毫米商用冲煮头与 PID 控温即热锅炉萃取专业级浓缩，蒸汽棒 20 秒打出绵密奶泡。内置 30 档锥刀研磨，从咖啡豆到一杯浓缩一气呵成。

reviews.author: Beatrice
reviews.comment: Taste is a genuine step above my cafe habit — and cheaper by the third week.

reviews.author: Hugo
reviews.comment: Excellent espresso; the learning curve for dialing in grind took a few days.

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.comment: Latte art quality microfoam at home. Cleanup is easier than my old machine.

description_en: Six precise temperature presets keep green tea at 80 °C and coffee at 93 °C, and hold them warm for an hour. The gooseneck spout pours slow and steady for pour-over beginners and obsessives alike.
description_zh: 六档精准控温：绿茶 80°C、咖啡 93°C，并可保温一小时。鹅颈壶嘴出水缓慢稳定，无论手冲新手还是老饕都得心应手。

reviews.author: Ines
reviews.comment: The 80 °C preset transformed my green tea. Pour-over control is superb.

reviews.author: Martin
reviews.comment: Heats fast and the lid seals well. Base could show the current temp more brightly.

reviews.author: Chloe
reviews.comment: Quiet, stable pouring and the keep-warm is perfect for slow Sunday mornings.

description_en: A 5.5-litre square basket fits a whole chicken, and dual-zone radiant heat crisps food with up to 90 percent less oil. Twelve one-touch presets cover fries to salmon, and every removable part is dishwasher safe.
description_zh: 5.5 升方形炸篮可容纳整只鸡，双区辐射加热令食物酥脆，用油量减少高达 90%。12 项一键预设从薯条到三文鱼，可拆部件均可用洗碗机清洗。

reviews.author: Derek
reviews.comment: Wings come out restaurant-crispy with a spray of oil. Big enough for the whole family.

reviews.author: Amara
reviews.comment: Heats quickly and evenly. It is a bit of a counter hog, but worth it.

reviews.author: Leo
reviews.comment: The salmon preset is foolproof. Cleanup is genuinely two minutes.

description_en: A 6-litre tank runs up to 50 hours at a whisper-quiet 26 dB, with a built-in hygrometer holding your target humidity automatically. The top-fill design refills without carrying the tank to the sink.
description_zh: 6 升水箱以 26 分贝的静音运行长达 50 小时，内置湿度计自动维持目标湿度。上注水设计无需搬水箱即可加水。

reviews.author: Fatima
reviews.comment: Bedroom stays at 55 percent humidity all night and I sleep better. Cannot hear it running.

reviews.author: George
reviews.comment: Top fill is brilliant. In hard-water areas, use filtered water to avoid mineral dust.

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.comment: Freed my winter skin from the radiator dryness. The auto mode just works.

description_en: Forged from 67-layer Damascus steel around a VG-10 core, hardened to 61 HRC with a hand-finished edge. The full-tang octagonal handle balances at the bolster for a controlled, fatigue-free grip.
description_zh: 大马士革 67 层锻打包裹 VG-10 钢芯，硬度 61 HRC，手工开刃。全龙骨八角刀柄在刀颈处配重平衡，握持稳定不易疲劳。

reviews.author: Chef Raul
reviews.comment: Paper-thin onion dices after three months of daily line work. Holds its edge remarkably.

reviews.author: Judith
reviews.comment: The balance makes prep feel effortless. A true step up from stamped knives.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.comment: Beautiful and sharp; hand-wash only, but that is expected at this steel.

description_en: Double-wall 316 stainless steel keeps drinks hot for 12 hours or iced for 24, with a leak-proof one-hand lid that locks for bag carry. The 500 ml body still fits every cup holder we tested.
description_zh: 316 不锈钢双层真空结构，保温 12 小时、保冷 24 小时；单手开合杯盖可锁定防漏，放心放进背包。500 毫升杯身适配我们测试过的所有杯架。

reviews.author: Mateo
reviews.comment: Coffee was still steaming after a morning hike. The lock button survives being knocked around a bag.

reviews.author: Anouk
reviews.comment: Ice cubes at lunch from a 7 am fill. Zero leaks in my laptop backpack.

reviews.author: Ibrahim
reviews.comment: Great heat retention; a wider mouth option would make cleaning even easier.

description_en: A 140 cm linen-shaded lamp with stepless dimming from candle-warm to daylight, controllable by touch, remote or app. The weighted base and fabric-wrapped stem sit securely in reading corners.
description_zh: 140 厘米亚麻灯罩落地灯，无级调光从烛光暖到日光色，支持触摸、遥控与 App 控制。配重底座与织物包裹灯杆，安稳立于阅读角落。

reviews.author: Tessa
reviews.comment: The warm end of the range makes the living room feel expensive. App scenes are handy for movie nights.

reviews.author: Aldo
reviews.comment: Solid and stable next to the armchair. Assembly took ten minutes alone.

reviews.author: Mei
reviews.comment: Reading light bright enough, and the linen casts a beautiful soft glow.

description_en: A ventilated gel-infused memory foam core with a contoured loft that supports side and back sleepers without pressure points. The bamboo-blend cover unzips for machine washing and sleeps cool.
description_zh: 透气凝胶记忆棉内芯，轮廓高度贴合侧睡与仰睡曲线，无压迫点。竹纤维混纺枕套可拆洗，触感清凉。

reviews.author: Rosa
reviews.comment: Neck pain from side sleeping eased within a week. It keeps its shape night after night.

reviews.author: Ben
reviews.comment: Supportive and cool; stomach sleepers may find the contour too high.

reviews.author: Isabel
reviews.comment: The washable cover survived a spill and came out like new.

description_en: A 3-layer 20K/20K waterproof-breathable shell with fully taped seams and pit zips that dump heat on climbs. The helmet-compatible hood and storm cuffs earn their keep on genuinely foul days.
description_zh: 三层 20K/20K 防水透气面料，全压胶接缝与腋下拉链在爬升时快速散热。可容纳头盔的风帽与防风袖口，在真正的坏天气里物尽其用。

reviews.author: Hillwalker Jo
reviews.comment: Six hours of Scottish drizzle, bone dry inside. Pit zips are the unsung hero.

reviews.author: Marc
reviews.comment: Packs into its own pocket and still breathes on steep ascents. True 3-layer value.

reviews.author: Priyanka
reviews.comment: Excellent shell; sizing runs slightly long in the body, size accordingly.

care: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low to reactivate DWR; no fabric softener.

name_zh: 云步日常美利奴休闲鞋
description_en: An 17 mm supercritical foam midsole with a merino wool upper that breathes in summer and insulates in winter. Machine washable, and the outsole is quietly grippy on wet pavement.
description_zh: 超临界发泡 17 毫米中底搭配美利奴羊毛鞋面，夏透气冬保暖。整机可机洗，湿滑路面亦有出色抓地力。

reviews.author: Nils
reviews.comment: All-day city walking, zero break-in. Threw them in the wash and they came out like new.

reviews.author: Camille
reviews.comment: Beautifully comfortable; sizing is generous, go half a size down.

reviews.author: Owen
reviews.comment: The wool keeps them odor-free even without socks in summer. Genuinely all-season.

sizing.fit: Roomy; take half a size down

care: Machine wash cold on gentle, air dry; do not tumble dry.

description_en: Full-grain vegetable-tanned leather cut from a single hide, saddle-stitched with waxed thread at eight stitches per inch. Six card slots and two bill compartments, and it Patinas beautifully.
description_zh: 整张植鞣全粒面皮革裁制，蜡线鞍缝每英寸八针。六个卡位与两个钞位，随岁月形成漂亮包浆。

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.comment: Three years in and the patina is gorgeous. Stitching has not moved a millimetre.

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.comment: Slimmer than my old wallet while holding more. The leather smells incredible.

reviews.author: Sung
reviews.comment: Stiff for the first fortnight, then it molds to your pocket perfectly.

care: Condition with leather balm twice a year; keep dry.

description_en: 18.5-micron merino knit at 200 g/m2 regulates temperature from trailhead to summit and resists odor across a multi-day trip. Flat lock seams sit comfortably under a pack's straps.
description_zh: 18.5 微米美利奴针织面料（200 g/m²），从山脚到山顶调节体温，多日行程不易产生异味。平锁接缝在背包肩带下依然舒适。

reviews.author: Erik
reviews.comment: Four days of hut-to-hut hiking without washing and it stayed fresh. Warm when damp, too.

reviews.author: Alina
reviews.comment: No itch at all, which my skin usually notices immediately. My default ski layer now.

reviews.author: Tomas
reviews.comment: Excellent regulation; sleeves run long which I actually prefer for gloves.

care: Machine wash cold, lay flat to dry; do not bleach.

name_zh: 远景 UV400 偏光太阳镜
description_en: Polarized nylon lenses cut glare off water and asphalt while block 100 percent of UVA/UVB, in a 24 g Italian acetate frame with spring hinges. Prescription-ready and shipped with a hard case.
description_zh: 偏光尼龙镜片消除水面与路面眩光，100% 阻隔 UVA/UVB；24 克意大利醋酸纤维镜架配弹簧铰链，支持验光配片，附硬质眼镜盒。

reviews.author: Marina
reviews.comment: Sailing with these is a different sport — water glare is gone entirely.

reviews.author: Diego
reviews.comment: Light and comfortable for long drives. Wish the case were slimmer.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.comment: Colour fidelity is neutral, not overly tinted. My optician fitted prescription lenses easily.

care: Clean with the microfibre cloth; store in the case.

name_zh: 都市行者 20 升通勤双肩包
description_en: A clamshell 20-litre pack with a floating, false-bottom laptop pouch that survived our 1-metre drop test. Weatherproof 900D recycled shell, luggage pass-through, and a quick-grab top pocket for transit cards.
description_zh: 20 升对开式通勤包，悬浮双层底笔记本袋通过 1 米跌落测试。900D 再生面料防泼水，附行李箱拉杆穿透带与随手取放的交通卡顶袋。

reviews.author: Viktor
reviews.comment: The false-bottom laptop pouch has saved my machine twice from drops. Organizes a full workday perfectly.

reviews.author: Jenna
reviews.comment: Sits flat on the back, looks smart in meetings. Side pocket fits a 1-litre bottle snugly.

reviews.author: Pablo
reviews.comment: Clamshell opening means nothing gets lost at the bottom. Commuter essential.

care: Spot clean with damp cloth; air dry.

description_en: A 110 x 110 cm square of 22-momme mulberry silk twill, hand-rolled and stitched at the edges. Warm as a layer, light as a whisper, and it packs to the size of a plum.
description_zh: 110 x 110 厘米 22 姆米桑蚕丝斜纹方巾，手工卷边缝制。保暖如一层薄衣，轻盈似一声耳语，收纳后仅李子大小。

reviews.author: Colette
reviews.comment: The twill has a beautiful liquid drape and the red is deep, not brassy. Elevates every coat.

reviews.author: Anja
reviews.comment: Silk keeps my neck warm on the bike and vanishes into a bag pocket.

reviews.author: Rosa
reviews.comment: Gorgeous gift packaging. Hand wash only, but that is normal for real silk.

care: Hand wash cold with silk detergent; hang to dry.

description_en: An anti-gravity perimeter frame carries 20 kg so well you forget it, with an adjustable torso (16-21 in) and a floating lid. Six external pockets and dual ice-tool loops round out a genuine multiday workhorse.
description_zh: 反重力外框背负系统在 20 公斤负载下近乎无感，背长 16-21 英寸可调，浮动顶盖设计。六个外部口袋与双冰镐挂环，是真正的多日徒步主力。

reviews.author: Thru-hiker Rae
reviews.comment: Nine days on the trail, zero hot spots. The floating lid swallowed a bear canister setup.

reviews.author: Milan
reviews.comment: Load transfer to the hips is superb — 18 kg felt like 12. Adjusting torso length took minutes.

reviews.author: Pia
reviews.comment: Brilliant carry; wish the hip belt pockets were slightly larger for a phone.

description_en: A 6 mm natural-rubber mat with a moisture-wicking polyurethane top that grips harder as you sweat. Alignment lines are subtly debossed, and it lies flat out of the box without curling.
description_zh: 6 毫米天然橡胶瑜伽垫，吸湿聚氨酯面层越出汗越防滑。体式对齐线以压纹呈现，开箱即平铺不卷边。

reviews.author: Hot-yoga Hannah
reviews.comment: Sweat-soaked bikram classes and my hands never slipped once. No rubber smell after airing.

reviews.author: Deniz
reviews.comment: Cushioning is great for knees; at 2.3 kg it is a studio mat more than a carry-everywhere mat.

reviews.author: Karin
reviews.comment: The alignment lines genuinely improved my down dog consistency.

name_zh: 铁握可调节哑铃 24 公斤
description_en: Dial from 2.5 to 24 kg in 2.5 kg steps with a twist of the handle; the locking plates seat with a satisfying click and never rattle. One dumbbell replaces a whole rack in a home gym corner.
description_zh: 旋转手柄即可在 2.5-24 公斤间以 2.5 公斤步进调节；锁片到位咔哒作响、纹丝不晃。一只哑铃替代整面哑铃架，适配家庭健身角。

reviews.author: HomeGym Harriet
reviews.comment: Supersets are finally quick — the dial turns in under two seconds and nothing wobbles.

reviews.author: Oskar
reviews.comment: Solid mechanism; the tray is long, so measure your shelf. Plates feel secure at every weight.

reviews.author: Renata
reviews.comment: Replaced five pairs of dumbbells. Drop it on carpet (accidentally, once) and it shrugged it off.

description_en: A 2.9 kg freestanding dome with dual vestibules and a full-coverage fly rated 3000 mm. Colour-coded poles pitch in under four minutes, and two doors end the climbing-over-your-partner era.
description_zh: 2.9 公斤自由站立穹顶帐篷，双前庭，外帐防水 3000 毫米。彩色编码帐杆四分钟内搭建完成，双门设计告别跨过同伴出门的日子。

reviews.author: Fernwalker
reviews.comment: Rode out a night of 60 km/h gusts in the Pyrenees. Vestibules fit both packs plus boots.

reviews.author: Sam & Jo
reviews.comment: Two doors is civilised. Pitch is genuinely under four minutes even at dusk in light rain.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.comment: Light and sturdy; condensation under the fly in still humid air, like every double-wall tent.

name_zh: 活力保温运动水壶 750 毫升
description_en: A 750 ml sports bottle with a high-flow bite valve that keeps water icy for 18 hours in a rubberised, cage-friendly body. The valve strips apart for real cleaning, not just rinsing.
description_zh: 750 毫升运动水壶，高流量咬嘴阀盖，橡胶握身适配车架水壶架，保冷 18 小时。阀盖可完全拆解清洗，不只是简单冲一冲。

reviews.author: Roadie Cal
reviews.comment: Ice survives century rides in summer. Flow rate is big enough to actually drink at speed.

reviews.author: Tri-Kat
reviews.comment: Fits every bottle cage I own. Taking the valve apart monthly keeps it fresh.

reviews.author: Boulders Ash
reviews.comment: Rubberised body dents invisibly when dropped on crag floors. Still insulated perfectly.

name_zh: 配速守护 GPS 跑步手表
description_en: A featherweight 38 g running watch with multi-band GPS, live pace-band alerts and 26 hours of logged GPS battery. Training load, VO2 trend and race predictor come standard, no subscription.
description_zh: 38 克轻量跑步手表，多频 GPS、实时配速带提醒与 26 小时 GPS 续航。训练负荷、VO2 趋势与比赛成绩预测均为标配，无需订阅。

specs.label: Metrics
specs.value: Pace band, load, VO2, race predictor

reviews.author: Marathoner Didi
reviews.comment: Pace band buzzing when I drift is my favourite coach. GPS lock under bridges is far better than my old watch.

reviews.author: TrailTom
reviews.comment: Multi-band GPS holds a line in canyon sections where others drift. 26 hours covers my 100k ambition.

reviews.author: 5k Sam
reviews.comment: Everything a runner needs without a subscription tax. Screen is a touch dim in direct sun.

description_en: Five layered latex bands from 5 to 60 kg of resistance, with door anchor, handles and ankle straps for a complete gym in a pouch. Colour-coded sleeves stop the roll-up guessing game.
description_zh: 五层乳胶阻力带覆盖 5-60 公斤，配门锚、手柄与脚踝带，一只收纳袋就是完整健身房。彩色外套标识阻力等级，卷收不再靠猜。

reviews.author: Traveller Nell
reviews.comment: Hotel-room workouts that actually load the back and shoulders. Door anchor holds firm.

reviews.author: Physio Max
reviews.comment: I prescribe these in clinic — the incremental resistance steps are perfectly judged.

reviews.author: Priya
reviews.comment: Great bands; powder smell aired out in a day. The pouch zips smoothly.

description_en: The Nexa Mechanical Keyboard focuses on a lightweight build that is easy to live with, with the everyday details done properly. It arrives well packaged and ready to use out of the box.
description_zh: Nexa 机械键盘专注于轻量化设计，日常使用毫无负担，日常细节同样考究。包装妥当，开箱即可使用。

reviews.comment: Arrived quickly and has been flawless in daily use. Would buy again.
A friend recommended it and they were right — my favourite purchase this year.

description_en: The Kite Wireless Mouse focuses on thoughtful ergonomics and quality materials, with the everyday details done properly. It arrives well packaged and ready to use out of the box.
